description:
LocalGateKeys keeps your passwords in an encrypted vault on your iPhone. There's no account to create and no server of ours holding your passwords: your vault is encrypted on the device and unlocked with Face ID or Touch ID.

FILL IN SECONDS
• AutoFill your logins in Safari and other apps, with suggestions in the QuickType bar
• Fill cards, addresses and other details in any text field (iOS 18 and later)
• Use LocalGateKeys for passkeys
• Safari offers to save a new login after you sign in

TWO-FACTOR CODES BUILT IN
• One-time codes right next to the login they belong to
• Scan a website's 2FA QR code, or bring codes over from your authenticator app
• Show the codes you choose on your Apple Watch

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR SECURITY
• A security check with a score: weak, reused and old passwords, and logins that could use two-factor codes
• Password history for every login
• Reminders before a card, passport or licence expires

MORE THAN PASSWORDS
• Cards, notes, identities, bank accounts, Wi-Fi, licences, API keys, SSH keys, subscriptions, warranties and more
• Attach documents and photos, stored encrypted in your vault
• Share one item securely: the other person opens it once, with a six-word code
• Import from many password managers and authenticator apps
• Recently deleted keeps items for 30 days, with Undo
• Fast search, sorting, favorites and a password generator

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads
• An optional app password, auto-lock, a clipboard that clears itself and a privacy cover in the app switcher
• Optional encrypted sync with LocalGateKeys on your Mac and your Windows PC, over your own Wi-Fi or through your own cloud folder
• Buying Pro sends only the App Store receipt to our licence server, so your purchase also unlocks LocalGateKeys for Windows. It is not linked to you.
whatsNew:
A big update.

• A new home: Vault, Sync, Security and Settings tabs, with search, sorting and favorites
• Security check: a score with weak, reused and old passwords
• Two-factor codes on your Apple Watch
• AutoFill cards and identities in any text field (iOS 18 and later)
• Attach files to your vault, encrypted, and sync them
• Share an item securely with a six-word code
• Import from many password managers and authenticator apps
• Recently deleted with Undo, password history and expiry reminders
• An optional app password
• A quick setup guide, and "What's new" after each update
• Wi-Fi sync finds your computer again after its address changes
• Your Pro purchase also unlocks LocalGateKeys for Windows
• Many fixes and accessibility improvements
promotionalText: New in 1.1: a security check, Apple Watch codes, file attachments, secure sharing and AutoFill for cards and identities.
